parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment includes an explicit request for the authors to "reassess and support their claim" regarding the limitations of 1-bit Adam. This is a direct action that the authors can take. Moreover, the comment provides concrete details on how to carry out this reassessment: it points to specific variants implemented in the 1-bit Adam paper (compressing the gradient and compressing the momentum), cites prior work [1] that already addressed leveraging local SGD with Adam, and names CADA as a method with which 1-bit Adam could trivially be combined. The steps are therefore not vague: the authors know precisely which claim to revisit, which existing variants and cited work contradict it, and which concrete counter-evidence to incorporate. Given the explicit action together with these concrete pointers, the comment meets the rubric level for an explicit action with concrete details on how to implement it.
